window_edge_projected_angle.angle_direction: Positive means the observed edge moves to image right as image y increases downward.
window_edge_projected_angle.uncertainty_basis: Manual marking uncertainty, short visible span, local ring curvature, reflections and ambiguous exact seat/ring boundary; not a statistical confidence interval.
